terra.problem: “That one runs the wrong way” uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
The reference to Papa being found after a long stretch in the dark invokes his backstory without identifying the drawer.
“They want to know how it’s done” assumes the people’s intention without marking it as Papa’s guess.
The explanation is generic and lacks Papa Dorin’s distinctive voice.
The LORD speaks of the whole nation, but “Nobody gets to” say they aren’t responsible extends that statement to every individual.
The line about checking cookie boxes twice has no clear connection to the promise that the vine will produce fruit.
